caption: This creamy avocado ice cream is the easiest healthy summer treat for your little one! 🥑🍌🍦 ✨ You’ll need: • ½ avocado • 1 ripe banana • ¼ cup whole milk • Optional: coconut flakes I made mine on a rolled ice cream tray, but you can also blend everything together and freeze it for a bit to get the perfect soft-serve texture. No added sugar—just naturally sweet, creamy goodness! 💚 Save this for your next hot summer day and let me know if your toddler loves it!
